content:
A woman died in a rollover crash near San Dario Avenue and Sherman Street in Laredo early Sunday morning, November 8, 2026.

Early reports indicate a vehicle overturned near the intersection, and police and emergency personnel responded to the scene. One woman was reported deceased at the scene.

Rain was falling across Laredo at the time, leaving roads potentially slick for drivers.

What caused the crash has not been confirmed, and the woman's name has not been released. No other injuries have been reported.

Drivers are advised to use caution in the area while emergency crews work the scene. This is a developing story, and Webb Watch 956 will update it as officials confirm more details.

Source: On-scene reports.
